notes.title: Build 1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Fixed glitched hiding spot in the doghouse on "Home Sweet Home".

- Fixed two areas on "Lucky Wheeze's" where enemies could not reach you.

- Added an additional "Tutorial" button to the map select screen for greater accessibility.

- Removed Herobrine
